changeSet.author: kabipay-dev
changeSet.comment: Add missing subscriptions for all active catalog modules and non-deleted tenants. Existing rows, including deleted or inactive subscriptions, are never modified. New subscriptions have no activation boundary or expiry; seat fields retain schema defaults. Tenant status, feature flags, module state, pricing and RBAC are unchanged. This is a one-time backfill, not a default subscription policy for future tenants.
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO kabipay_ops.tenant_subscription ( id, tenant_id, module_id, status, activated_at, expires_at ) SELECT gen_random_uuid(), tenant.id, module.id, 'ACTIVE', NULL, NULL FROM kabipay_ops.tenant AS tenant CROSS JOIN kabipay_ops.module AS module WHERE tenant.is_deleted = false AND module.is_active = true AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM kabipay_ops.tenant_subscription AS existing WHERE existing.tenant_id = tenant.id AND existing.module_id = module.id ) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, module_id) DO NOTHING;
